verses.original: שׁוֹטְט֞וּ בְּחוּצ֣וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֗ם וּרְאוּ־ נָ֤א וּדְעוּ֙ וּבַקְשׁ֣וּ בִרְחוֹבוֹתֶ֔יהָ אִם־ תִּמְצְא֣וּ אִ֔ישׁ אִם־ יֵ֛שׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מִשְׁפָּ֖ט מְבַקֵּ֣שׁ אֱמוּנָ֑ה וְאֶסְלַ֖ח לָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: šō·wṭ·ṭū bə·ḥū·ṣō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim ū·rə·’ū- nā ū·ḏə·‘ū ū·ḇaq·šū ḇir·ḥō·w·ḇō·w·ṯe·hā ’im- tim·ṣə·’ū ’îš ’im- yêš ‘ō·śeh miš·pāṭ mə·ḇaq·qêš ’ĕ·mū·nāh wə·’es·laḥ lāh
verses.literal: Go up and down the streets of Jerusalem Look now and take note search her squares If you can find a single person . . . . . . anyone who acts justly anyone who seeks the truth then I will forgive the city

verses.original: וְאִ֥ם חַי־ יְהֹוָ֖ה יֹאמֵ֑רוּ לָכֵ֥ן לַשֶּׁ֖קֶר יִשָּׁבֵֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im ḥay- Yah·weh yō·mê·rū lā·ḵên laš·še·qer yiš·šā·ḇê·‘ū
verses.literal: Although they say . . . As surely as the LORD lives they are swearing falsely . . .

verses.original: יְהֹוָ֗ה עֵינֶיךָ֮ הֲל֣וֹא לֶאֱמוּנָה֒ הִכִּ֤יתָה אֹתָם֙ וְֽלֹא־ חָ֔לוּ כִּלִּיתָ֕ם מֵאֲנ֖וּ קַ֣חַת מוּסָ֑ר חִזְּק֤וּ פְנֵיהֶם֙ מִסֶּ֔לַע מֵאֲנ֖וּ לָשֽׁוּב׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ‘ê·ne·ḵā hă·lō·w le·’ĕ·mū·nāh hik·kî·ṯāh ’ō·ṯām wə·lō- ḥā·lū kil·lî·ṯām mê·’ă·nū qa·ḥaṯ mū·sār ḥiz·zə·qū p̄ə·nê·hem mis·se·la‘ mê·’ă·nū lā·šūḇ
verses.literal: O LORD do not Your eyes look for truth You struck them but they felt no pain You finished them off but they refused to accept discipline They have made their faces harder than stone and refused to repent

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֣י אָמַ֔רְתִּי אַךְ־ דַּלִּ֖ים הֵ֑ם נוֹאֲל֕וּ כִּ֣י לֹ֤א יָדְעוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî ’ā·mar·tî ’aḵ- dal·lîm hêm nō·w·’ă·lū kî lō yā·ḏə·‘ū de·reḵ Yah·weh miš·paṭ ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem
verses.literal: Then I said They are only the poor they have played the fool for they do not know the way of the LORD the justice of their God

verses.original: אֵֽלֲכָה־ לִּ֤י אֶל־ הַגְּדֹלִים֙ וַאֲדַבְּרָ֣ה אוֹתָ֔ם כִּ֣י הֵ֗מָּה יָדְעוּ֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ יְהוָ֔ה מִשְׁפַּ֖ט אֱלֹהֵיהֶ֑ם אַ֣ךְ הֵ֤מָּה יַחְדָּו֙ שָׁ֣בְרוּ עֹ֔ל נִתְּק֖וּ מוֹסֵרֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·lă·ḵāh- lî ’el- hag·gə·ḏō·lîm wa·’ă·ḏab·bə·rāh ’ō·w·ṯām kî hêm·māh yā·ḏə·‘ū de·reḵ Yah·weh miš·paṭ ’ĕ·lō·hê·hem ’aḵ hêm·māh yaḥ·dāw šā·ḇə·rū ‘ōl nit·tə·qū mō·w·sê·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: I will go to the powerful and speak to them Surely they know the way of the LORD the justice of their God But they too with one accord had broken the yoke and torn off the chains

verses.original: עַל־ כֵּן֩ הִכָּ֨ם אַרְיֵ֜ה מִיַּ֗עַר זְאֵ֤ב עֲרָבוֹת֙ יְשָׁדְדֵ֔ם נָמֵ֤ר שֹׁקֵד֙ עַל־ עָ֣רֵיהֶ֔ם כָּל־ הַיּוֹצֵ֥א מֵהֵ֖נָּה יִטָּרֵ֑ף כִּ֤י רַבּוּ֙ פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֔ם עָצְמ֖וּ מְשֻׁבוֹתֵיהֶם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- kên hik·kām ’ar·yêh mî·ya·‘ar zə·’êḇ ‘ă·rā·ḇō·wṯ yə·šā·ḏə·ḏêm nā·mêr šō·qêḏ ‘al- ‘ā·rê·hem kāl- hay·yō·w·ṣê mê·hên·nāh yiṭ·ṭā·rêp̄ kî rab·bū piš·‘ê·hem ‘ā·ṣə·mū mə·šu·ḇō·ṯē·hɛm
verses.literal: Therefore . . . a lion from the forest will strike them down a wolf from the desert will ravage them A leopard will lie in wait near their cities and everyone who ventures out . . . will be torn to pieces For their rebellious acts are many and their unfaithful deeds are numerous

verses.original: אֵ֤י לָזֹאת֙ אֶסְלוֹחַ לָ֔ךְ בָּנַ֣יִךְ עֲזָב֔וּנִי וַיִּשָּׁבְע֖וּ בְּלֹ֣א אֱלֹהִ֑ים וָאַשְׂבִּ֤עַ אוֹתָם֙ וַיִּנְאָ֔פוּ וּבֵ֥ית זוֹנָ֖ה יִתְגֹּדָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê lā·zōṯ ʾɛs·lō·aḥ lå̄ḵ bā·na·yiḵ ‘ă·zā·ḇū·nî way·yiš·šā·ḇə·‘ū bə·lō ’ĕ·lō·hîm wā·’aś·bi·a‘ ’ō·w·ṯām way·yin·’ā·p̄ū ū·ḇêṯ zō·w·nāh yiṯ·gō·ḏā·ḏū
verses.literal: Why . . . should I forgive you . . . Your children have forsaken Me and sworn by gods that are not gods I satisfied their needs yet they committed adultery and assembled at the houses of prostitutes

verses.original: סוּסִ֥ים מְיֻזָּנִ֖ים מַשְׁכִּ֣ים הָי֑וּ אִ֛ישׁ אֶל־ אֵ֥שֶׁת רֵעֵ֖הוּ יִצְהָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: sū·sîm mə·yuz·zā·nîm maš·kîm hā·yū ’îš ’el- ’ê·šeṯ rê·‘ê·hū yiṣ·hā·lū
verses.literal: They are well-fed lusty stallions each neighing after his neighbor’s wife

verses.original: הַֽעַל־ אֵ֥לֶּה לוֹא־ אֶפְקֹ֖ד נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֑ה וְאִם֙ בְּג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר־ כָּזֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·‘al- ’êl·leh lō·w- ’ep̄·qōḏ nə·’um- Yah·weh wə·’im bə·ḡō·w ’ă·šer- kā·zeh lō ṯiṯ·naq·qêm nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Should I not punish them for these things declares the LORD Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this

verses.original: עֲל֤וּ בְשָׁרוֹתֶ֙יהָ֙ וְשַׁחֵ֔תוּ וְכָלָ֖ה אַֽל־ תַּעֲשׂ֑וּ הָסִ֙ירוּ֙ נְטִ֣ישׁוֹתֶ֔יהָ כִּ֛י ל֥וֹא לַיהוָ֖ה הֵֽמָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·lū ḇə·šā·rō·w·ṯe·hā wə·ša·ḥê·ṯū wə·ḵā·lāh ’al- ta·‘ă·śū hā·sî·rū nə·ṭî·šō·w·ṯe·hā kî lō·w Yah·weh hêm·māh
verses.literal: Go up through her vineyards and ravage them but do not finish them off . . . Strip off her branches for they do not belong to the LORD

verses.original: כִּי֩ בָג֨וֹד בָּגְד֜וּ בִּ֗י בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וּבֵ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה נְאֻם־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḇā·ḡō·wḏ bā·ḡə·ḏū bî bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·ḇêṯ yə·hū·ḏāh nə·’um- Yah·weh
verses.literal: For the house of Israel and the house of Judah have been utterly unfaithful . . . to Me declares the LORD

verses.original: כִּֽחֲשׁוּ֙ בַּיהוָ֔ה וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ לֹא־ ה֑וּא וְלֹא־ תָב֤וֹא עָלֵ֙ינוּ֙ רָעָ֔ה וְחֶ֥רֶב וְרָעָ֖ב ל֥וֹא נִרְאֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ki·ḥă·šū Yah·weh way·yō·mə·rū lō- hū wə·lō- ṯā·ḇō·w ‘ā·lê·nū rā·‘āh wə·ḥe·reḇ wə·rā·‘āḇ lō·w nir·’eh
verses.literal: They have lied about the LORD and said He will not do anything harm will not come to us we will not see sword or famine

verses.original: וְהַנְּבִיאִים֙ יִֽהְי֣וּ לְר֔וּחַ וְהַדִּבֵּ֖ר אֵ֣ין בָּהֶ֑ם כֹּ֥ה יֵעָשֶׂ֖ה לָהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nə·ḇî·’îm yih·yū lə·rū·aḥ wə·had·dib·bêr ’ên bā·hem kōh yê·‘ā·śeh lā·hem
verses.literal: The prophets are but wind for the word is not in them So let their own predictions befall them

verses.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י צְבָא֔וֹת יַ֚עַן דַּבֶּרְכֶ֔ם אֶת־ הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה הִנְנִ֣י נֹתֵן֩ דְּבָרַ֨י בְּפִ֜יךָ לְאֵ֗שׁ וְהָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֛ה עֵצִ֖ים וַאֲכָלָֽתַם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ya·‘an dab·ber·ḵem ’eṯ- had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh hin·nî nō·ṯên də·ḇā·ray bə·p̄î·ḵā lə·’êš wə·hā·‘ām haz·zeh ‘ê·ṣîm wa·’ă·ḵā·lā·ṯam
verses.literal: Therefore this is what the LORD God of Hosts says Because you have spoken this . . . word I will make My words a fire in your mouth and this people the wood it consumes

verses.original: הִנְנִ֣י מֵבִיא֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם גּ֧וֹי מִמֶּרְחָ֛ק בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֑ה גּ֣וֹי׀ אֵיתָ֣ן ה֗וּא גּ֤וֹי מֵעוֹלָם֙ ה֔וּא גּ֚וֹי לֹא־ תֵדַ֣ע לְשֹׁנ֔וֹ וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁמַ֖ע מַה־ יְדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nî mê·ḇî ‘ă·lê·ḵem gō·w mim·mer·ḥāq bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl nə·’um- Yah·weh gō·w ’ê·ṯān hū gō·w mê·‘ō·w·lām hū gō·w lō- ṯê·ḏa‘ lə·šō·nōw wə·lō ṯiš·ma‘ mah- yə·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: Behold I am bringing a distant nation against you O house of Israel declares the LORD It is an established nation an ancient . . . nation a nation whose language you do not know and whose speech . . . you do not understand

verses.original: אַשְׁפָּת֖וֹ כְּקֶ֣בֶר פָּת֑וּחַ כֻּלָּ֖ם גִּבּוֹרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ’aš·pā·ṯōw kə·qe·ḇer pā·ṯū·aḥ kul·lām gib·bō·w·rîm
verses.literal: Their quivers are like open graves they are all mighty men

verses.original: וְאָכַ֨ל קְצִֽירְךָ֜ וְלַחְמֶ֗ךָ יֹאכְלוּ֙ בָּנֶ֣יךָ וּבְנוֹתֶ֔יךָ יֹאכַ֤ל צֹאנְךָ֙ וּבְקָרֶ֔ךָ יֹאכַ֥ל גַּפְנְךָ֖ וּתְאֵנָתֶ֑ךָ יְרֹשֵׁ֞שׁ עָרֵ֣י מִבְצָרֶ֗יךָ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה בּוֹטֵ֥חַ בָּהֵ֖נָּה בֶּחָֽרֶב׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·ḵal qə·ṣî·rə·ḵā wə·laḥ·me·ḵā yō·ḵə·lū bā·ne·ḵā ū·ḇə·nō·w·ṯe·ḵā yō·ḵal ṣō·nə·ḵā ū·ḇə·qā·re·ḵā yō·ḵal gap̄·nə·ḵā ū·ṯə·’ê·nā·ṯe·ḵā yə·rō·šêš ‘ā·rê miḇ·ṣā·re·ḵā ’ă·šer ’at·tāh bō·w·ṭê·aḥ bā·hên·nāh be·ḥā·reḇ
verses.literal: They will devour your harvest and food they will consume your sons and daughters they will eat up your flocks and herds they will feed on your vines and fig trees With the sword they will destroy the fortified cities in which you trust . . .

verses.original: וְגַ֛ם בַּיָּמִ֥ים הָהֵ֖מָּה נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֑ה לֹֽא־ אֶעֱשֶׂ֥ה אִתְּכֶ֖ם כָּלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḡam bay·yā·mîm hā·hêm·māh nə·’um- Yah·weh lō- ’e·‘ĕ·śeh ’it·tə·ḵem kā·lāh
verses.literal: Yet even in those days declares the LORD I will not make a full end of you

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּ֣י תֹאמְר֔וּ תַּ֣חַת מֶ֗ה עָשָׂ֨ה יְהֹוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֵ֛ינוּ לָ֖נוּ אֶת־ כָּל־ אֵ֑לֶּה וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר עֲזַבְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתִי֙ וַתַּעַבְד֞וּ אֱלֹהֵ֤י נֵכָר֙ בְּאַרְצְכֶ֔ם כֵּ֚ן תַּעַבְד֣וּ זָרִ֔ים בְּאֶ֖רֶץ לֹ֥א לָכֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh kî ṯō·mə·rū ta·ḥaṯ meh ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū lā·nū ’eṯ- kāl- ’êl·leh wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem ka·’ă·šer ‘ă·zaḇ·tem ’ō·w·ṯî wat·ta·‘aḇ·ḏū ’ĕ·lō·hê nê·ḵār bə·’ar·ṣə·ḵem kên ta·‘aḇ·ḏū zā·rîm bə·’e·reṣ lō lā·ḵem
verses.literal: And when the people ask For what offense has the LORD our God done all these things to us You are to tell them Just as you have forsaken Me and served foreign gods in your land so will you serve foreigners in a land that is not your own

verses.original: הַגִּ֥ידוּ זֹ֖את בְּבֵ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב וְהַשְׁמִיע֥וּהָ בִיהוּדָ֖ה לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gî·ḏū zōṯ bə·ḇêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·haš·mî·‘ū·hā ḇî·hū·ḏāh lê·mōr
verses.literal: Declare this in the house of Jacob and proclaim it in Judah

verses.original: שִׁמְעוּ־ נָ֣א זֹ֔את עַ֥ם סָכָ֖ל וְאֵ֣ין לֵ֑ב עֵינַ֤יִם לָהֶם֙ וְלֹ֣א יִרְא֔וּ אָזְנַ֥יִם לָהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šim·‘ū- nā zōṯ ‘am sā·ḵāl wə·’ên lêḇ ‘ê·na·yim lā·hem wə·lō yir·’ū ’ā·zə·na·yim lā·hem wə·lō yiš·mā·‘ū
verses.literal: Hear . . . this O foolish and senseless . . . people who have eyes but do not see who have ears but do not hear

verses.original: הַאוֹתִ֨י לֹא־ תִירָ֜אוּ נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֗ה אִ֤ם מִפָּנַי֙ לֹ֣א תָחִ֔ילוּ אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֤מְתִּי חוֹל֙ גְּב֣וּל לַיָּ֔ם חָק־ עוֹלָ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יַעַבְרֶ֑נְהוּ וַיִּֽתְגָּעֲשׁוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א יוּכָ֔לוּ וְהָמ֥וּ גַלָּ֖יו וְלֹ֥א יַעַבְרֻֽנְהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ha·’ō·w·ṯî lō- ṯî·rā·’ū nə·’um- Yah·weh ’im mip·pā·nay lō ṯā·ḥî·lū ’ă·šer- śam·tî ḥō·wl gə·ḇūl lay·yām ḥāq- ‘ō·w·lām wə·lō ya·‘aḇ·ren·hū way·yiṯ·gā·‘ă·šū wə·lō yū·ḵā·lū wə·hā·mū ḡal·lāw wə·lō ya·‘aḇ·run·hū
verses.literal: Do you not fear Me declares the LORD Do you not tremble before Me the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea an enduring barrier it cannot cross The waves surge but they cannot prevail They roar but cannot cross it

verses.original: וְלָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ הָיָ֔ה לֵ֖ב סוֹרֵ֣ר וּמוֹרֶ֑ה סָ֖רוּ וַיֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·‘ām haz·zeh hā·yāh lêḇ sō·w·rêr ū·mō·w·reh sā·rū way·yê·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: But these people have stubborn and rebellious hearts They have turned aside and gone away

verses.original: וְלֹֽא־ אָמְר֣וּ בִלְבָבָ֗ם נִ֤ירָא נָא֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הַנֹּתֵ֗ן גֶּ֛שֶׁם וְיֹרֶה וּמַלְק֖וֹשׁ בְּעִתּ֑וֹ שְׁבֻע֛וֹת חֻקּ֥וֹת קָצִ֖יר יִשְׁמָר־ לָֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō- ’ā·mə·rū ḇil·ḇā·ḇām nî·rā nā ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū han·nō·ṯên ge·šem wə·yō·rɛh ū·mal·qō·wōš bə·‘it·tōw šə·ḇu·‘ō·wṯ ḥuq·qō·wṯ qā·ṣîr yiš·mār- lā·nū
verses.literal: They have not said in their hearts Let us fear . . . the LORD our God who gives the rains both autumn and spring in season who keeps for us the appointed weeks of harvest

verses.original: עֲוֺנוֹתֵיכֶ֖ם הִטּוּ־ אֵ֑לֶּה וְחַטֹּ֣אותֵיכֶ֔ם מָנְע֥וּ הַטּ֖וֹב מִכֶּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ă·wō·nō·w·ṯê·ḵem hiṭ·ṭū- ’êl·leh wə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯê·ḵem mā·nə·‘ū haṭ·ṭō·wḇ mik·kem
verses.literal: Your iniquities have diverted these from you your sins have deprived you of My bounty

verses.original: כִּי־ נִמְצְא֥וּ בְעַמִּ֖י רְשָׁעִ֑ים יָשׁוּר֙ כְּשַׁ֣ךְ יְקוּשִׁ֔ים הִצִּ֥יבוּ מַשְׁחִ֖ית אֲנָשִׁ֥ים יִלְכֹּֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- nim·ṣə·’ū ḇə·‘am·mî rə·šā·‘îm yā·šūr kə·šaḵ yə·qū·šîm hiṣ·ṣî·ḇū maš·ḥîṯ ’ă·nā·šîm yil·kō·ḏū
verses.literal: For among My people are wicked men they watch like fowlers lying in wait they set a trap to catch men

verses.original: כִּכְלוּב֙ מָ֣לֵא ע֔וֹף כֵּ֥ן בָּתֵּיהֶ֖ם מְלֵאִ֣ים מִרְמָ֑ה עַל־ כֵּ֥ן גָּדְל֖וּ וַֽיַּעֲשִֽׁירוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kiḵ·lūḇ mā·lê ‘ō·wp̄ kên bāt·tê·hem mə·lê·’îm mir·māh ‘al- kên gā·ḏə·lū way·ya·‘ă·šî·rū
verses.literal: Like cages full of birds so their houses are full of deceit Therefore . . . they have become powerful and rich

verses.original: שָׁמְנ֣וּ עָשְׁת֗וּ גַּ֚ם עָֽבְר֣וּ דִבְרֵי־ רָ֔ע דִּ֣ין לֹא־ דָ֔נוּ דִּ֥ין יָת֖וֹם וְיַצְלִ֑יחוּ וּמִשְׁפַּ֥ט אֶבְיוֹנִ֖ים לֹ֥א שָׁפָֽטוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šā·mə·nū ‘ā·šə·ṯū gam ‘ā·ḇə·rū ḏiḇ·rê- rā‘ dîn lō- ḏā·nū dîn yā·ṯō·wm wə·yaṣ·lî·ḥū ū·miš·paṭ ’eḇ·yō·w·nîm lō šā·p̄ā·ṭū
verses.literal: They have grown fat and sleek and have excelled in the deeds of the wicked They have not taken up the cause . . . . . . of the fatherless that they might prosper nor have they defended the rights of the needy

verses.original: הַֽעַל־ אֵ֥לֶּה לֹֽא־ אֶפְקֹ֖ד נְאֻם־ יְהֹוָ֑ה אִ֚ם בְּג֣וֹי אֲשֶׁר־ כָּזֶ֔ה לֹ֥א תִתְנַקֵּ֖ם נַפְשִֽׁי׃ס
verses.transliteration: ha·‘al- ’êl·leh lō- ’ep̄·qōḏ nə·’um- Yah·weh ’im bə·ḡō·w ’ă·šer- kā·zeh lō ṯiṯ·naq·qêm nap̄·šî
verses.literal: Should I not punish them for these things? declares the LORD Should I not avenge Myself on such a nation as this

verses.original: שַׁמָּה֙ וְשַׁ֣עֲרוּרָ֔ה נִהְיְתָ֖ה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: šam·māh wə·ša·‘ă·rū·rāh nih·yə·ṯāh bā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: A horrible and shocking thing has happened in the land

verses.original: הַנְּבִיאִ֞ים נִבְּא֣וּ־ בַשֶּׁ֗קֶר וְהַכֹּהֲנִים֙ יִרְדּ֣וּ עַל־ יְדֵיהֶ֔ם וְעַמִּ֖י אָ֣הֲבוּ כֵ֑ן וּמַֽה־ תַּעֲשׂ֖וּ לְאַחֲרִיתָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: han·nə·ḇî·’îm nib·bə·’ū- ḇaš·še·qer wə·hak·kō·hă·nîm yir·dū ‘al- yə·ḏê·hem wə·‘am·mî ’ā·hă·ḇū ḵên ū·mah- ta·‘ă·śū lə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯāh
verses.literal: The prophets prophesy falsely and the priests rule by their own authority My people love it so but what will you do in the end
